Two structural notes for anything that hides the ghost in future: opacity 0 does kill a backdrop-filter (the filtered backdrop composites through the element's opacity), and the disc cannot be reached from the stick's own .held because body.append(padBlur, pad) puts it FIRST — any held/hidden state it needs has to be published on :root.

Two rules out of it: a hold must start on the earliest SYNCHRONOUS signal the user gives (focusin on the tap), never on a state some later handler sets; and a measurement's baseline must be a value nothing else writes — kbBaseH is captured at focus while not holding, so a re-tap with the keys up cannot adopt the shortened viewport as 'no keyboard'.

A verify-*.mjs is a browser gate: it is never imported by the client, never by the server, and contributes nothing to the image, exactly like server/test/**.
